properties.name: RBK0049
properties.notes: Planning permission 16/10362/FUL for 7 net additional homes (C3) granted on 28/02/2017.. Demolition of existing conservatory and creation of paved pedestrian route. Retention of existing public house on ground floor and basement. Conversion of ancillary accommodation on upper floors to 4 x one-bedroom flats (C3) and provision of roof terraces/ balcony with associated elevational alterations and alterations to the existing flue. Erection of part single/ part two storey building to create 3 x two-bedroom houses (C3) with basements, gardens and roof terraces. Erection of part single/ part two-storey building including pitched front roof and front dormers to create 1 x two-bedroom flat (C3) and 1 x one-bedroom flat (C3) with associated terraces and access stairs to the first floor accommodation.
properties.site-address: The Cap In Hand, 174 Hook Rise North, Surbiton
